management_steps.details: Children (>12 months): 0.5 mL/kg/dose once daily (if poor response, increase frequency to 12 hourly). Adults: 10-20 mL once or twice daily (for anal fissures: 10-20 mL once daily, increase frequency to 12 hourly if poor response).
